name: Doorkeeper
overview: Scripture portrays the role of the doorkeeper as one of humble yet vital service in God's house, exemplified by the psalmist's preference to be a doorkeeper in the Lord's courts rather than dwell in wickedness (Psalms 84:10). The doorkeeper, or porter, is entrusted with watchfulness and authority over the entrance, as Jesus illustrates in Mark 13:34, emphasizing vigilance and responsibility. In John 10, the doorkeeper opens the door to the true shepherd, who calls and leads his sheep, distinguishing the legitimate entry from thieves and robbers, underscoring the spiritual significance of the doorkeeper's role in safeguarding God's people.
